compatibilityDifferences.title: Hall sensor calibration after display replacement
compatibilityDifferences.description: Impextrom documents that after replacing the Galaxy Z Flip5 display, the main screen can shut off because Hall-sensor readings may be affected by slight magnet polarity or strength differences; calibration may be required.
